summary: Added the missing sync command that generated-tree guidance, MCP error text, and docs all reference.
reason: The scaffold references 'lever-pp-cli sync' in missing-store guidance (data_source.go), sync-hint text, and the learnHookSkipList, but generated no command. sync <company> fetches all open postings (mode=json) and persists them under a company-scoped key (postings:<company>) with durability verification before recording sync state. Mirrors the greenhouse package's sync command shape.
validated_outcome: go build ./... and go vet ./... pass; live end-to-end: 'lever-pp-cli sync leverdemo' persisted 388 postings, and 'postings list leverdemo --data-source local' returned all 388 from the store with source=local and a synced_at stamp.
